credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/lodgepole.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. BRACED: a first-year pine on a thin red-brown stem rising from ash, its whorl of seed needles (cotyledons) fanned out like a spiked crown, the seed coat still caught on one needle tip, the terminal bud pushing up. Gesture: the whorl draws in, then flares wide and shivers, settles. Sport: 'Chief Joseph'.
